# robots.txt for YICDVP - Young Innovators Club
# https://dvpyic.dpdns.org/

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Block admin/internal paths
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /_headers
Disallow: /learning-hub/my-learning
Disallow: /learning-hub/classroom/
Disallow: /student/

# Sitemap location
Sitemap: https://dvpyic.dpdns.org/sitemap.xml

# Dynamic sitemap of published blog posts (generated by the Worker)
Sitemap: https://dvpyic.dpdns.org/sitemap-blog.xml

# Dynamic sitemap of public instructor profiles (generated by the Worker)
Sitemap: https://dvpyic.dpdns.org/sitemap-instructors.xml

# Dynamic sitemap of public student projects (generated by the Worker)
Sitemap: https://dvpyic.dpdns.org/sitemap-projects.xml

# Dynamic sitemap of published learning-hub courses (generated by the Worker)
Sitemap: https://dvpyic.dpdns.org/sitemap-courses.xml

# Dynamic sitemap of published workshops (generated by the Worker)
Sitemap: https://dvpyic.dpdns.org/sitemap-workshops.xml

# IndexNow key file (Bing / Yahoo / Yandex / Seznam / Naver instant indexing).
# Keep this URL in sync with SOURCES: https://api.indexnow.org/IndexNow
# https://dvpyic.dpdns.org/indexnow-4b249edb452b1c6276c655cc97a3bf41.txt


# Google-specific
# /api/ is intentionally NOT blocked for Googlebot: its headless Chrome runs
# the React app, which calls /api/events and other endpoints to populate the
# page. If we block /api/ here, the live render fails (404/403 in the page
# resources), and Googlebot captures a broken screenshot. Other bots in the
# / and Yandex sections below keep the /api/ block — they don't run JS, so
# the API endpoints are useless to them and only waste crawl budget.
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /learning-hub/my-learning
Disallow: /learning-hub/classroom/
Disallow: /student/

# Bing-specific
User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /learning-hub/my-learning
Disallow: /learning-hub/classroom/
Disallow: /student/


# Yandex-specific
User-agent: Yandex
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /learning-hub/my-learning
Disallow: /learning-hub/classroom/
Disallow: /student/
